input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 meets the preferred position outright: there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, Customer pays only for Services ordered in an executed Order Form, and declining further Order Forms is expressly not a breach or shortfall. This is reinforced by Section 7.1 (Vendor may not impose an unidentified minimum-use charge), Section 12.3 (Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment), and Section 9.4 (termination without cause with Customer owing only accrued Fees and prepaid Fees refunded). No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage appears anywhere in the document, so the fallback true-up/reduction mechanics are unnecessary. No redline required.
